title: Pan wo Nameru na!
titleNative: パンをナメるな！
synopsis: No education, no work experience, no friends. Muyu Uchiki, a 19-year-old girl who has been a shut-in for two years, was living a self-defeating life day after day, But then a turning point finally comes her way. Her aunt, who lives in Kamakura, invites Muyu to help out at her bakery. She refuses the unexpected request at first. However, her mother is eager to get her out of the house (by bribing her with money), and she reluctantly agrees to go... Yumu arrives in Kamakura with no idea what to expect, until her aunt delivers a shocking message...! Set in a bakery in Kamakura, a heartwarming comedy about a girl's daily struggles! (Source: Ura Sunday, translated)
